name: Barracks
desc1: This long stone chamber is well-organized and clean as can be. Rows
desc2: of wooden beds and chests line the walls of the room, sleeping areas
desc3: for the many dwarven warriors. An large space cleared out in the
desc4: centre of the hall holds eating tables and an area for recreation,
desc5: should a dwarf not choose to enter the city for leisure. A heavy iron
desc6: door breaks the face of the wall to the north.
